title: Pluggable X6 node views and package responsibility refactor
objective: Make the Ant Design card the complete rendered X6 node, introduce a vendor-neutral node-view discriminator and internal renderer catalog for future shapes, reorganize x6-canvas by responsibility, and consolidate behavioral tests and API snapshots under one tests root.
validations: pnpm.cmd --filter @grafting/ui check/test: passed with 5/5 component contracts
pnpm.cmd exec nx run ui:api-check --skip-nx-cache: intentional baseline update reviewed, then normal check passed with no AntD type leak
pnpm.cmd --filter @grafting/x6-canvas check/test: passed with 12/12 canvas, card-root, catalog, selection, interaction, edge, and lifecycle contracts
pnpm.cmd exec nx run x6-canvas:api-check --skip-nx-cache: intentional baseline update reviewed, then normal check passed with no X6, React-shape, or AntD type leak
Card SSR contracts prove the ant-card element is the component root, owns the full height, accent, and selection border, and has no decorative wrapper
Catalog contracts prove card resolution is vendor-runtime-free, unknown views fail explicitly, and view definitions own component, data, size, and ports
pnpm.cmd --filter @grafting/architecture-studio check/test/build: passed with 5/5 tests and view card selected from the single PROJECTION configuration
Architecture Studio production build passed (2596 modules; JS 1186.53 kB raw / 352.80 kB gzip; separate Worker and Wasm asset)
pnpm.cmd docs:check: repository map, artifact manifest, Graph IR, Rust API, and TypeScript API drift checks passed (49 nodes, 48 edges)
pnpm.cmd audit --prod: no known vulnerabilities found
.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m automation.coordination --root .: passed with 24 task records, including completed X6-002
risks: A public node-view key must remain presentation-only and must not become a TypeScript graph classification or layout rule.
Adding generic extension hooks too early could leak React or X6 types; the initial extension point remains an internal catalog selected by a Grafting-owned string union.
Moving tests must update native scripts and Nx inputs atomically so evidence is not silently skipped.
The AntD public entry point still produces a large initial Studio bundle; component-level entry points or code splitting remain a separate performance task.
